title: Hoodline Accused of Misleadingly Attributing AI-Generated Articles to Human Authors

behaviors.text: In 2023, the news site Hoodline is reported to have begun publishing AI-generated articles with fake bylines, headshots, and biographies, allegedly misleading [person] into believing they were authored by real journalists.
This practice diminishes [person] trust and exemplifies the potential dangers of AI in journalism.
Despite a disclaimer, the use of AI was not transparent.
